name: Free Site Templates for Bootstrap, Tailwind, and HTML5
summary: Listing of free and premium website templates built with Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS and HTML5, from admin dashboards to landing pages.
description: Free and premium website templates and themes based on HTML5, Tailwind CSS and the Bootstrap framework: business sites, admin dashboards and UI kits, landing pages, portfolio and resume, one-page templates and more. Each card links to a preview and download and notes whether the template is free or part of the All-Access plan.
